properties.name: PDM MEMS Microphone Audio Capture
properties.description: Pulse Density Modulation (PDM) microphone sampling procedure. Each MEMS microphone produces a 1-bit PDM bitstream. The XMOS xCORE decimation filter converts PDM to PCM at 16000 Hz. Frame size: 256 samples, hop size: 128 samples. USB Audio Class 1.0 transport to host.
